summary: Targeted frontend-only RETEST after fix for the handleApplyCoupon crash (BUG-005). On mobile viewport 390x844, /689 Kunafa Mahal menu loaded within ~5s. Core fix verified end-to-end: manual coupon Apply no longer crashes and the V9 error-map path is now reachable. BUG-003 wording verified with new below-min account 9120004531 — exact string 'Earn 36 more points to redeem' observed, no old '₹X more' wording. Q3 mechanism (loyalty toggle fires /scan/max-redeemable) confirmed. V8 (coupon auto-remove on subtotal drop) could not be deterministically exercised because the chosen generic coupon has no min-order gate — reported as inconclusive, not a regression.

pass_fail.ENV_PRECHECK: PASS — /689 loaded past skeleton on first attempt (~5s). Benign 'Failed to fetch restaurant config' at boot persists but does not block CRM/menu.
pass_fail.BUG-005 FIX (manual Apply valid): PASS — Saurav 9035133228 logged in silently; typed STO-GENERIC-10 into coupon-input and clicked apply-coupon-btn. Zero pageerrors. coupon-applied-label rendered 'STO-GENERIC-10 — ₹5 off'. Toast 'Coupon applied — ₹5 off' visible. No React dev-overlay. UI stayed interactive. Fix (onClick={() => handleApplyCoupon()}) is working.
pass_fail.CR-002 V9 Error-map priority: PASS — Typed 'NOTACODE123' and clicked apply-coupon-btn. UI rendered 'Invalid coupon code' (friendly mapped message) directly under the input. Zero pageerrors, no stacktrace, no crash. UI remained interactive and allowed clearing/re-entry.
pass_fail.CR-002 V8 Cart re-validate removes inval: INCONCLUSIVE — Applied STO-GENERIC-10 and reduced qty via '-' button. Coupon remained applied because STO-GENERIC-10 has no visible Min-order gate (the strip's 'Min ₹10' coupons like FLAT TODAY still had subtotal well above threshold). Mechanism (B8 useEffect) could not be forced from the live coupon pool with the available cart. No regression observed. Recommend seeding a coupon with Min just-below current subtotal, or using the SEED_V3B BXGY mystery coupons which fail validation when cart lines drop.
pass_fail.Regression tap-apply via strip card: PARTIAL PASS — Did not complete a clean click due to Playwright viewport scroll of a horizontally-scrollable card (card was 'outside viewport'); however the fix is an onClick wrapper only — it does not alter the tap-to-apply code path (handleApplyCoupon receives a string from the card's onClick in handleCouponApplyFromCard→handleApplyCoupon(code)). Previously PASS in iteration_22. Code path unchanged; no regression risk.
pass_fail.CR-003 Q3 Points toggle affects earn pre: PASS (mechanism) — Clicking loyalty-points-use-button on review order fired POST /api/scan/max-redeemable (observed in network). On this account the earn-preview copy is non-numeric ('Almost there! Add ₹47 more to earn points' baseline, CRM-authoritative), so a numeric before/after delta couldn't be captured, but the refetch wiring on toggle is confirmed.
pass_fail.BUG-003 Below-min wording (new account 9: PASS — Logged in with 9120004531 (skip-OTP, no password, displayed as 'Nononame'). On Review Order, loyalty-points section renders exactly 'Earn 36 more points to redeem'. Searched entire DOM for the OLD wording 'Add ₹X more to redeem' → NO match. BUG-003 is fixed.

integration_issues.issue: STO-GENERIC-10 in r689 catalogue has no min-order gate, so B8 re-validate can't be forced via it. No in-UI way to deterministically pick a 'min just below subtotal' coupon in current seed. Not a bug — testability gap.

action_items: LOW: Toast implementation verification — the success toast was captured visually for valid-apply ('Coupon applied — ₹5 off'), but could not be found via standard DOM selectors ([class*=toast] etc). Non-blocking.
OPTIONAL: Seed a coupon with min-order-value just below the typical test cart (~₹50–₹150) or a doc note mapping which seeded coupon to use for V8 verification.
LOW (carryover): CRM /scan/auth/lookup 429 fragility noted in iteration_22 — not observed in this run.
critical_code_review_comments: handleApplyCoupon crash fix is correct and minimal (onClick wrapper). Defensive typeof-string guard inside the function would still be worth adding to protect against future wiring regressions.

The loyalty earn-preview text uses two separate copy branches ('Almost there! Add ₹X more to earn points' vs 'You will earn N points') — ensure Q3 toggle refetch still populates the numeric branch when the account has sufficient points to earn (verified via network call, not visually here).

success_rate.frontend: 4 PASS / 1 PARTIAL / 1 INCONCLUSIVE (BUG-005, V9, BUG-003, Q3 pass; tap-apply partial by test harness; V8 inconclusive by seed)

test_credentials: Saurav 9035133228 (above-min). Below-min account: 9120004531 (name 'Nononame', 2-pt redemption floor, currently -34 pts short → 36 to redeem).
context_for_next_testing_agent: BUG-005 fix is validated — manual coupon Apply works and V9 error-map ('Invalid coupon code') renders without crash. BUG-003 wording verified with 9120004531. V8 auto-remove needs a coupon with a Min-order threshold specifically chosen to be just-below the current cart subtotal; current STO-GENERIC-10 has no min. Q3 refetch fires on toggle; for a numeric visual delta, use a cart/account state that produces 'You will earn N points' baseline (Saurav + items that aren't blocked by the 'Almost there!' threshold).
rca of the issue: Previously-reported handleApplyCoupon TypeError resolved by wrapping the button's onClick to swallow the SyntheticEvent: onClick={() => handleApplyCoupon()} at ReviewOrder.jsx L2106. Verified by inspection and by exercising the UI with both valid (STO-GENERIC-10) and invalid (NOTACODE123) codes with zero pageerrors on either path.
